label: Change audit_logs.request_id from uuid to varchar(128)

precheck.sql:
SELECT (data_type = 'uuid') AS result
                  FROM information_schema.columns
                 WHERE table_schema = 'public'
                   AND table_name = 'audit_logs'
                   AND column_name = 'request_id'

execute.sql:
ALTER TABLE "public"."audit_logs"
                  ALTER COLUMN "request_id" TYPE character varying(128)
                  USING "request_id"::text

postcheck.sql:
SELECT (data_type = 'character varying' AND character_maximum_length = 128) AS result
                  FROM information_schema.columns
                 WHERE table_schema = 'public'
                   AND table_name = 'audit_logs'
                   AND column_name = 'request_id'
